title: Exchange rates, monthly: Sri Lanka rupees and Chinese yuan per US dollar; nominal and real effective exchange rates of China and the real effective exchange rate of the United States (broad basket, 2020 = 100)
source: Bank for International Settlements, BIS Data Portal (datasets WS_XRU and WS_EER)
series: WS_XRU M.LK.LKR.E (lkr_usd_eop, end of month), M.LK.LKR.A (lkr_usd_avg, monthly average), M.CN.CNY.A (cny_usd_avg); WS_EER M.N.B.CN (cn_neer), M.R.B.CN (cn_reer), M.R.B.US (us_reer)
license: BIS Data Portal terms (https://data.bis.org/help/legal, 2026-10-14): 'The use of the statistics is unrestricted, provided that: if the statistics are reproduced, the BIS must be cited in your publication or product as the source of the statistics; if the statistics will be translated into another language, a statement must be included in your publication or product that the translation is not an official BIS translation'. The Chinese labels in the book are not an official BIS translation.
citation: Source: BIS, bilateral exchange rates (WS_XRU) and effective exchange rates (WS_EER).
notes: Bilateral rates are units of national currency per US dollar (a rise is a depreciation of the national currency, as e in the book). The effective rates are indices, 2020 = 100 (the 2020 mean of cn_reer is 100.0), and rise when the currency appreciates: the opposite direction to e. The real effective rates are CPI-based.
